llm.summary: The package and runtime instructions are coherent with a Russian-language business-analytics skill, but it includes local install/test scripts (install.sh, smoke-test.sh) that you should inspect before executing.

dimensions.detail: Name, description, SKILL.md, examples and config.yaml consistently describe a CFO/CEO-focused analytics assistant (dashboards, unit economics, forecasts, investor reports). Required environment, binaries and config paths declared in the registry are minimal/none and match the stated offline/chat-driven workflow.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions center on filling config.yaml and invoking chat triggers (e.g., 'дашборд', 'покажи KPI'). README also instructs running install.sh and a smoke-test under ~/.openclaw/skills; the SKILL.md does not request external credentials or to read unrelated system files. However, the author explicitly asks you to run included shell scripts (install.sh, test/smoke-test.sh) — those scripts can perform arbitrary local actions, so they should be reviewed before execution.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Registry lists no install spec (instruction-only), yet the bundle includes install.sh, build.sh and smoke-test.sh. The provided build.sh is benign (local packaging/zip logic, no network I/O). No remote download URLs or package registry installs are present in the visible files. Risk is limited to running the included shell scripts from an unknown source — review their contents and avoid running them as root or on production hosts until audited.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials. All configuration is driven by a local config.yaml file the user fills. There are no obvious requests for unrelated secrets or cloud credentials in the SKILL.md and visible files.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Flags are normal (always:false, agent invocation allowed). README/install guidance suggests installing under ~/.openclaw/skills which is a normal per-user install location. Nothing requests system-wide always-on privilege, but the included install scripts may write files into the user environment — inspect them for unexpected modifications or attempts to change other skills or system settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent with its stated purpose and asks you to provide a local config rather than secrets. The main residual risk is executing included shell scripts (install.sh, test/smoke-test.sh) from an unverified source. Before running any installer or smoke-test: 1) open and read install.sh and test/smoke-test.sh and look for network calls (curl/wget/ssh/scp), eval/base64/decode+exec patterns, rm -rf, sudo/apt/yum/pacman steps, or commands that write outside the skill directory; 2) run the installer in an isolated environment (VM or throwaway container) if you need to test it; 3) do not run as root; 4) back up any important data and configuration and verify the author/source (no homepage or provenance provided); 5) if you are not comfortable auditing shell scripts, ask the publisher for an explicit install checklist or a signed release, or request a review of the install.sh content before proceeding.
